summary.scale: Stockfish UCI_Elo, derived from CCRL calibration

scoreInterval.method: Hoeffding bound on independent bounded color-pair scores, conditional on the selected openings. Calibration and hardware uncertainty excluded.

summary.method: Fit one Elo to the mean expected score across reference settings, weighting games equally. Draws contribute half a point. The two setup pilot games are excluded.
summary.limitation: Small, fixed-opening multi-anchor performance estimate, not a population rating. Stockfish calibration is approximate and engine-specific. Node and browser performance can differ. No FIDE, Chess.com or Lichess claim.
summary.studyDesign: Exploratory: reference settings were added after earlier results. The nominal independence interval does not account for adaptive reference-setting selection.

settings.clockPolicy: Both engines start at 120s with 1s increment. Bot uses its normal fixed per-move budget, clipped to remaining time. Stockfish uses UCI clock management. Opening moves are uncharged.
